newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Land, S'pore Bus to buy property.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Land, S'pore Bus to buy property.

text.p: Keppel Land Ltd said on Monday it had agreed with Singapore Bus Service (1978) Ltd to purchase 47 units of the condominium Avenue Park for a total of Singapore $161.12 million.
Keppel Land said in a statement the agreement was made as a result of an enbloc sale and public tender by the registered owners of the condominium, Avenue Park.
The units to be purchased would be held by Mansfield Developments Pte Ltd, a company which was currently wholly owned by Keppel Land but in which Singapore Bus would take a 48 percent stake.
The statement quoted a Keppel official as saying the company did not have any immediate redevelopment plans for the condominium, which is located in central Singapore.
The statement said the purchase was not expected to have any material impact on the net tangible assets and earnings per share of Keppel Land or Singapore Land for the year ending December 31, 1997.
